title: The Midwives' Ledger
text: The midwives' guild has kept a ledger for a hundred Years, and in the last ten its pages have filled with births marked in ash: children who are born with a thumbprint on the brow and never cry. The guild says the mark runs in one Great House's blood, and will name it if the Houses ask.

options.label: Ask the guild, and name the House to the magistrates.

outcomes.text: You give the magistrates a name. Whether it was the one written in the ledger, only you and the midwives know.

options.label: Pay the guild to burn the ledger, before any House is named.

outcomes.text: The ledger burns in the guildhall stove. The midwives are paid, and silent, and they keep a second copy.

options.label: Leave the midwives to their work. Marked or not, they are children.

outcomes.text: You let it lie. The marked children grow up quiet and watchful, and they all sit together at the Commons.

blamed.text: The magistrates read the name aloud in the square. From then on the named House's children are watched in the street; its blood is spoken of in whispers that never stop.
